name: garmin-mcp-worker
description: Read-only remote MCP server for your own Garmin data, on Garmin's official Personal API, deployed to Cloudflare Workers with OAuth.

GARMIN_API_KEY.description: Your Garmin **Personal API** key. Create one in [Garmin Connect → Settings → Personal API](https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken); it is shown only once.

LOGIN_PASSWORD.description: A long password of your choice. You type it on this Worker's sign-in page when connecting Claude, so only you can authorize access.

TIMEZONE.description: IANA time zone for "today", e.g. `Europe/London` or `Africa/Johannesburg`.

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth grants (hashed) and the cached Garmin token. Created automatically.
